mapper.select: SELECT e.entry_uid AS entryUid, e.headword, e.part_of_speech AS partOfSpeech, e.clean_text AS cleanText, e.sort_order AS sortOrder, l.display_name AS dictionaryName FROM dictionary_entry e INNER JOIN dictionary_library l ON l.dictionary_uid = e.dictionary_uid WHERE e.normalized_headword = #{normalizedHeadword} AND e.status = 'active' AND l.enabled = 1 AND l.status IN ('installed', 'imported', 'published') ORDER BY l.sort_order ASC, e.sort_order ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT 5
